The top 72 share no three vertices and have short squared edges 2,2 with opposite short pair, next D=448 gives gap (2sqrt2-sqrt7)/6. Source integer checker verifies 1152 genuine orthogonal 4-frame vertex permutations, their transitive orbit of maxima and 48 regular edge-sqrt2 tetrahedra. Norm of 3-fold wedge is separately convex in every vertex, extending maximum over solid; equality forces any positive barycentric split of an assumed nonvertex max to yield two vertex maxima sharing the other three vertices, contradicting triple uniqueness. All maximizers vertex supported; no numerical extrapolation.
